intent: Welcome: What Gator can do adds system homes and cross-repository work
notes: "What Gator can do" now makes two larger claims. First, a Gatorized
repository can be the durable home for a system you operate, such as
Databricks administration, cloud infrastructure or release engineering.
Its charters then hold the procedures, tripwires and lessons that usually
live in people's heads. Second, one capable agent can work across a
system of Gatorized repositories, with durable context at each repository
boundary, instead of reaching first for a swarm of agents.
The opening line now covers the cross-repository idea. Each new section
